#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# -*- coding: UTF-8 -*-
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 24e_granger_bivar_markdown.R
# Genera informe Markdown con lectura ejecutiva, tabla con estrellitas, Bonferroni
# y diagnósticos para los Granger bivariados (24d).
#
# IN:
#   output/tables/granger_bivar_summary.csv
#   output/tables/granger_bivar_diagnostics.csv
#   data/processed/tasas/var_ready.csv (para rango de años)
# OUT:
#   output/reports/granger_bivar_summary.md
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here); library(readr); library(dplyr); library(janitor)
  library(tibble); library(stringr); library(purrr)
})

msg <- function(...) message("[24e] ", paste0(...))
stars_p <- function(p){
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p <= 0.001) return("***")
  if (p <= 0.010) return("**")
  if (p <= 0.050) return("*")
  if (p <= 0.100) return("†")
  ""
}

# Rutas
p_sum  <- here::here("output","tables","granger_bivar_summary.csv")
p_diag <- here::here("output","tables","granger_bivar_diagnostics.csv")
p_var  <- here::here("data","processed","tasas","var_ready.csv")
p_md   <- here::here("output","reports","granger_bivar_summary.md")

stopifnot(file.exists(p_sum), file.exists(p_diag), file.exists(p_var))

# Lecturas
sumdf  <- suppressMessages(read_csv(p_sum, show_col_types = FALSE)) |> clean_names()
diagdf <- suppressMessages(read_csv(p_diag, show_col_types = FALSE)) |> clean_names()
vr     <- suppressMessages(read_csv(p_var, show_col_types = FALSE))  |> clean_names()

# Rango de años
rng <- if ("ano" %in% names(vr)) {
  paste0(min(vr$ano, na.rm = TRUE), "–", max(vr$ano, na.rm = TRUE))
} else "Años: N/D"

# Control Bonferroni (solo X→Y)
sum_xy <- sumdf |> filter(dir == "X→Y")
m_tests <- nrow(sum_xy)
alpha   <- 0.05
alpha_bonf <- alpha / max(1, m_tests)

# Elegimos especificación principal p=1 (si existe); si no, la de menor p_value
pick_main <- function(df){
  if (any(df$lags == 1)) {
    df |> filter(lags == 1)
  } else {
    df |> arrange(p_value) |> slice(1)
  }
}
main_rows <- sum_xy |> group_by(y) |> group_modify(~ pick_main(.x)) |> ungroup()

# Pequeña traducción legible
name_map <- c(
  d_l_hc_rate      = "Δlog tasa HC",
  d_l_he_rate      = "Δlog tasa HE",
  d_l_det_tot_rate = "Δlog tasa Det Tot",
  d_l_det_ext_rate = "Δlog tasa Det Ext"
)
main_rows <- main_rows |>
  mutate(y_read = ifelse(y %in% names(name_map), name_map[y], y))

# Construir narrativa por Y
fmt_pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", 100*x))
fmt_num <- function(x, d=3) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format="f", digits=d, big.mark=","))

mk_line <- function(r){
  ylab <- r$y_read
  p    <- r$p_value
  star <- stars_p(p)
  lag1 <- r$coef_x_l1 %||% NA_real_
  p1   <- r$p_x_l1 %||% NA_real_
  lag2 <- r$coef_x_l2 %||% NA_real_
  p2   <- r$p_x_l2 %||% NA_real_
  sigb <- if (!is.na(p) && p <= alpha_bonf) " (Bonferroni ✓)" else ""
  eff  <- if (!is.na(lag1)) paste0("coef(lag1)≈", fmt_num(lag1, 3), if (!is.na(p1)) paste0(" (p=", fmt_num(p1,3), ")") else "") else "coef(lag1)=NA"
  eff2 <- if (!is.na(lag2)) paste0(", coef(lag2)≈", fmt_num(lag2, 3), if (!is.na(p2)) paste0(" (p=", fmt_num(p2,3), ")") else "") else ""
  paste0("- **", ylab, "**: F=", fmt_num(r$f,3), ", p=", fmt_num(p,3), " ", star, sigb, " → ",
         if (!is.na(p) && p < 0.05) "**Evidencia de Granger**." else "no evidencia.",
         " Magnitud: ", eff, eff2, ".")
}

`%||%` <- function(a,b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# Prepara líneas
lines_exec <- apply(main_rows, 1, function(row) {
  r <- as.list(row)
  mk_line(r)
})

# Tabla Markdown compacta
mk_md_table <- function(df, cols){
  x <- df |> select(all_of(cols))
  # encabezados
  hdr <- paste0("| ", paste(names(x), collapse = " | "), " |")
  sep <- paste0("|", paste(rep("---", ncol(x)), collapse = "|"), "|")
  body <- apply(x, 1, function(r) paste0("| ", paste(r, collapse = " | "), " |"))
  c(hdr, sep, body)
}

# Ensambla tabla “X→Y” (todas las especificaciones)
tab_cols <- c("y_readable","lags","n_obs","f","p_value","star","f_rev","p_rev","coef_x_l1","p_x_l1","coef_x_l2","p_x_l2")
sumdf <- sumdf %>%
  mutate(y_readable = ifelse(y %in% names(name_map), name_map[y], y)) %>%
  # Orden estético por variable y lag
  arrange(match(y, names(name_map)), lags) %>%
  # Redondeos friendly
  mutate(
    f          = ifelse(is.na(F), NA, round(F, 6)),
    p_value    = round(p_value, 6),
    f_rev      = round(F_rev, 6),
    p_rev      = round(p_rev, 6),
    coef_x_l1  = round(coef_x_l1, 6),
    p_x_l1     = round(p_x_l1, 6),
    coef_x_l2  = round(coef_x_l2, 6),
    p_x_l2     = round(p_x_l2, 6)
  )

tab_md <- mk_md_table(sumdf, tab_cols)

# Diagnósticos resumen por especificación
diag_lines <- diagdf %>%
  mutate(
    y_read = ifelse(y %in% names(name_map), name_map[y], y),
    ok_serial = ifelse(is.na(p_serial), "NA", ifelse(p_serial > 0.10, "OK", "WARN")),
    ok_stab   = ifelse(is.na(stable), "NA", ifelse(stable, "OK", "FAIL")),
    root_txt  = ifelse(is.na(max_root), "NA", sprintf("%.3f", max_root))
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    line = paste0("- ", y_read, " (p=", lags, "): residuos=", ok_serial,
                  ", estabilidad=", ok_stab, " (max_root=", root_txt, ").")
  ) %>% pull(line)

# IRFs existentes
p_fig1 <- here::here("output","figures","irf_det_tot_irf_p1.png")
p_fig2 <- here::here("output","figures","irf_det_ext_irf_p1.png")
have_irf1 <- file.exists(p_fig1)
have_irf2 <- file.exists(p_fig2)

# Construir el Markdown
dir.create(dirname(p_md), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
con <- file(p_md, open = "wt", encoding = "UTF-8")

writeLines(c(
  "# Informe Granger bivariado (anual)",
  "",
  paste0("_Generado: ", Sys.Date(), " · Cobertura: ", rng, "_"),
  "",
  "## Resumen ejecutivo",
  paste0("- Corrección por múltiples comparaciones: Bonferroni α/m = ",
         sprintf("%.4f", alpha_bonf), " (m=", m_tests, ")."),
  lines_exec,
  "",
  "## Tabla de resultados (X = Δlog % extranjeros → Y = Δlog tasa)",
  "",
  tab_md,
  "",
  "## Diagnósticos",
  diag_lines,
  "",
  "## Notas metodológicas",
  "- Granger indica capacidad **predictiva temporal**, no causalidad estructural.",
  "- Especificación principal: VAR bivariado con p=1 (T≈14 tras Δlog). p=2 se reporta como sensibilidad.",
  "- Δlog: diferencia del logaritmo natural; los coeficientes pueden leerse como **elasticidades** aproximadas.",
  "",
  if (have_irf1 || have_irf2) "## Impulse Response Functions (IRF)" else NULL,
  if (have_irf1) paste0("![](", normalizePath(p_fig1, winslash = "/"), ")") else NULL,
  if (have_irf2) paste0("![](", normalizePath(p_fig2, winslash = "/"), ")") else NULL,
  ""
), con = con)
close(con)

msg("Reporte → ", p_md)
